label_provenance.summary: PROPOSED labels written by an AI agent (claude-sonnet-agent) from reading the JVA-bookstore source at each finding's line and its callers. This is NOT independent human adjudication and must not be used for training or scored evaluation as-is.
label_provenance.scan_command: devsec scan-run --checkout JVA-bookstore --commit dd48d1240fdbc3e5b2ffe8b0a2e3ad65e10d57f5 --profile full --no-laya --out artifacts/laya-rescan/out --db-path artifacts/laya-rescan/scan.db --workdir artifacts/laya-rescan/wd --json
label_provenance.scanner_caveat: Only Semgrep produced findings. The 29-finding T09 sheet included SpotBugs/other scanners that could not run here, so this export is a strict subset of that coverage.
label_provenance.labels_not_derived_from: Laya output or rule names alone
label_provenance.human_review_required: Two distinct human reviewers must confirm or flip each row, then set adjudicated=true, independently_adjudicated=true and reviewers=[name1,name2] themselves. The agent has deliberately left adjudicated=false, independently_adjudicated=false, reviewers=[] on every row so the training gate (QR-17) stays closed.
label_provenance.single_project_note: All rows share project_id jva-bookstore; dataset.prepare needs >=4 independent project/family groups, so these rows alone cannot be exported.

rows.rationale: The statement passed to stmt.execute is a concatenation of string literals only (schema bootstrap DDL in ensureSchema); no variable, parameter or request value reaches it, so no injection is possible.
rows.evidence: CartDAO.java:506 - stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS carts (" + "id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY," + ... + ")") with every operand a literal through line 515

rows.rationale: Same ensureSchema() DDL pattern: concatenated string literals only, executed once at startup behind a schemaReady flag. No external input can reach the SQL text.
rows.evidence: CartDAO.java:540 - stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS cart_items (" + "id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY," + ... + ")") all operands literal through line 549

rows.rationale: Anonymous DO block built by concatenating literals to create the shipper_status enum; no variable is interpolated, so there is no tainted data.
rows.evidence: ShipperDAO.java:86 - stmt.execute("DO $$ BEGIN " + "IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pg_type ..." + "END IF; END $$;") all literals (lines 86-89)

rows.rationale: CREATE TABLE shippers DDL assembled only from string literals inside ensureSchema(); nothing user-controlled is concatenated.
rows.evidence: ShipperDAO.java:91 - stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS shippers (" + "id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY, " + ... + "updated_at TIMESTAMP NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)") all literals (lines 91-101)

rows.rationale: CREATE TABLE user_addresses DDL built purely from string literals (including the literal default 'Viet Nam'); no input reaches it, so the concatenation is cosmetic line-wrapping.
rows.evidence: UserAddressDAO.java:206 - stmt.execute("CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS user_addresses (" + "id SERIAL PRIMARY KEY," + ... + ")") all literals through line 224

rows.rationale: java.util.Random is seeded with a constant plus the book id to generate reproducible synthetic engagement metrics (total_sold, rating_count). It protects no secret, token or authorization decision, so CWE-330 does not apply.
rows.evidence: DBUtil.java:800 - Random random = new Random(20251017L + (bookId * 1973)); values only feed insert.setInt/setDouble for book_metrics seed data

rows.rationale: generateOTP() draws the 6-digit email-verification code from java.util.Random (predictable LCG, not SecureRandom). The OTP gates account registration in AuthServlet.handleVerifyOTP, so a security-relevant secret uses a non-cryptographic PRNG. Practical exploitability is limited (10 min expiry, 5 attempts), so severity is a reviewer call, but the weakness is real.
rows.evidence: OTPUtil.java:18 - Random random = new Random(); int otp = 100000 + random.nextInt(900000); caller AuthServlet.java:257 stores/emails it, AuthServlet.java:284 verifies it to create the user
